title: Reported AI-Generated Videos Purported to Show Kosovo Diaspora Mobilization for Vetëvendosje Before Snap Elections

behaviors.text: Videos reported as AI-generated circulated on Facebook and Instagram before Kosovo's June 7, 2026 snap elections, purportedly depicting diaspora voters mobilizing for Vetëvendosje and Albin Kurti.
The videos allegedly used fabricated travel and interview scenes to suggest mass diaspora support for Vetëvendosje.
